messages.text: Map the chain from a Wireless Communication market requirement to a measurable parameter and then to a required capability of Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer.

| Wireless Communication market requirement | Measurable parameter / test target | Required Signal Generator capability | Required Signal Analyzer capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Beamforming / Massive MIMO: Massive MIMO uses many antenna elements and combines beamforming with spatial multiplexing; beamforming is essential for system efficiency, especially at mmWave [41]. | Multi-channel MIMO generation/analysis, integrated fading simulation, beamforming component accuracy, and simultaneous measurement on ≤24 ports are called out as test needs [41]. | R&S SMW200A can scale from single-path vector signal generator to multichannel MIMO receiver tester, supports up to 8 signal sources, up to 64 fading channels, up to 8 RF paths with SGT100A modules, and MIMO fading scenarios including 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 8x4, 4x8 and 2x4x4 [6]. | 5G NR multi-channel analysis is linked to R&S VSE 5G MIMO analysis software [41]. |
| Higher frequencies / mmWave / early 6G: more spectrum bands and higher frequencies are linked to transition-to-6G RF performance demand [40]. | Early 6G research is associated with up to 4 GHz signal generation bandwidth, up to 8 GHz signal bandwidth, generic OFDM analysis, 4096QAM / multi-modulation, and flat signals over the entire frequency range [40]. | R&S SMW200A RF path A covers 100 kHz to 67 GHz [2], and the wideband baseband main module supports RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz [3]. | R&S FSW covers 8 GHz to 85 GHz models, with FSW85 plus FSW-B90G extending to 90 GHz [10]; FSW analysis bandwidth options include 8.312 GHz with FSW-B8001 [12]. |
| OTA base-station conformance: higher frequencies and Massive MIMO make conducted testing impractical and OTA testing necessary [41]. | 3GPP TS 38.141-2 OTA receiver tests include OTA sensitivity, OTA reference sensitivity, dynamic range, adjacent channel selectivity, blocking, receiver spurious emissions, receiver intermodulation, and in-channel selectivity [51]. | The main vector signal generator for 5G NR OTA base-station receiver tests is R&S SMW200A, with 5G NR software option R&S SMW-K144 [50]. | OTA receiver spurious emissions require a spectrum analyzer; listed analyzers include R&S FSW, R&S FSV, R&S FSVA, R&S FSV3000, R&S FSVA3000, and R&S FPS [50]. |
| Network energy saving: rising energy costs drive MNOs to boost efficiency, and base stations/components have substantial energy-saving potential [38]. | Measurement needs include power consumption optimization, power statistics over time, device activity versus power consumption, and real-time power / voltage / current statistics [38]. | Energy-saving amplifier development uses an envelope signal for tracker generated in real time and a turnkey solution based on VSG + VSA + software; R&S SMW-K546 is listed [38]. | The same turnkey VSG + VSA + software solution lists R&S FSW-K18 for energy-saving amplifier development [38]. |
| NTN / satellite wireless links: NTN test setups must include high path loss, Doppler shift, time delay, delay variance, atmospheric effects, Faraday effect, scintillation, and weather influences [43]. | E2E NTN testing key parameters include update interval, delay, Doppler, and pathloss [29]. | R&S SMW200A with firmware ≥5.30, B14 or B15, and R&S SMW-K820 customized dynamic fading supports satellite trajectory modeling, frequency-dependent atmospheric effects, longer path delays, enhanced Doppler, up to 1073 ms delay, and up to ±1 MHz Doppler [27]. | R&S FSW / FSWX support satellite payload testing measurements including EVM, ACLR, group delay, DVB-S2X analysis, and phase-coherent multichannel measurement [42]. |
| 5G NR SAN conformance testing for NTN: the source links SAN testing to 3GPP TS 38.108 and TS 38.181 [47]. | SAN conformance chapters include conducted transmitter characteristics, conducted receiver characteristics, conducted performance characteristics, radiated transmitter characteristics, radiated receiver characteristics, and radiated performance characteristics [46]. | SMW B10/B14 is stated as a solution up to 160 MHz supporting TS 38.181 Rel.17 SAN receiver/performance requirements, delay requirements, and residual Doppler requirements for LEO; SMW B9/B15 is recommended up to 200 MHz with the same requirement coverage [33]. | Chapter 6 and Chapter 9 transmitter characteristics need a spectrum analyzer, and 5G NR options on R&S FSW / FSVA3000 support Chapter 6 and 9 measurements [46]. |

Network Infrastructure T&M drivers › Solution mapping 摘要
依 [[MWC2025---WIC-INFRA]]：

- [[Beamforming]] / [[Massive MIMO]]：[[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S SGT100A]]、[[R&S VSE]]、[[R&S NRQ6]]、[[R&S NRPM]]、[[R&S ZNBT]]。
- [[OTA testing]] / base station conformance：[[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S PWC200]]、5G NR Test Case Wizard、[[3GPP TS 38.141-2]]。
- Higher frequencies / mmWave / early 6G：[[R&S SMA100B]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S SMM100A]]、[[R&S SMBV100B]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSVA3000]]、[[R&S PVT360A]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S ZNA]]、[[R&S ZNA67EXT]]、mmWave front ends / frequency converters。
- Digital design & power：[[VNA]]、probes、phase noise analyzer、power supplies、multimeter、oscilloscopes、signal source。
- Network energy saving：[[R&S NGP800]]、[[R&S RTO]] / [[R&S RTP]]、RT-ZHD07、RT-ZC31、[[R&S SMW-K546]]、[[R&S FSW-K18]]。
- [[O-RU testing]]：[[O-RAN test manager]]、[[R&S VSE]]、[[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSVA3000]]、O-RU tester C/U/S/M planes、[[R&S SMW200A]] / [[R&S SMBV100B]]、[[R&S PVT360A]]、[[R&S RTO6]]。
- Network densification / small cells：[[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S FSV]]、[[R&S FE44A]]、[[R&S CMQ200]]、[[R&S CMPHEAD30]]、Wireless Manufacturing Test（WMT）。

R&S SMW200A
[[R&S SMW200A]] 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 vector signal generator；依 `R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications` `Version 31.00`（`May 2026`），RF path A 可覆蓋 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`，RF path B 可覆蓋至 `44 GHz`，並可由 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel MIMO receiver tester（來源：[[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]）。

R&S SMW200A › Signal routing and baseband main module
| Code | Name / description | Order No. | 原文說明 / 限制 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `R&S®SMW-B13` | Signal routing and baseband main module，one I/Q path to RF section | `1413.2807.02` | Standard baseband section；not compatible with `R&S®SMW-BxxxxO` frequency options。 |
| `R&S®SMW-B13T` | Signal routing and baseband main module，two I/Q paths to RF section | `1413.3003.02` | Standard baseband section；若要安裝 RF path B 需 `B13T` 或 `B13XT`；not compatible with `R&S®SMW-BxxxxO` frequency options。 |
| `R&S®SMW-B13XT` | Wideband baseband main module，two I/Q paths to RF section | `1413.8005.02` | Wideband baseband section；RF modulation bandwidth up to `2 GHz`。 |

- Standard baseband section：`R&S®SMW-B13` 或 `R&S®SMW-B13T`；RF modulation bandwidth 最高 `160 MHz`；可安裝 `R&S®SMW-B10` standard baseband generator 與 `R&S®SMW-B14` fading simulator。
- Wideband baseband section：`R&S®SMW-B13XT`；RF modulation bandwidth 最高 `2 GHz`；可安裝 `R&S®SMW-B9` / `R&S®SMW-B9F` wideband baseband generator 與 `R&S®SMW-B15` fading simulator and signal processor。

R&S SMW200A › 文件依據
- 來源：[[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]。
- 文件名稱：`R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator – Configuration guide`。
- 文件代碼：`PD 3606.8037.92`。
- 文件版次：`Version 06.00`。
- 文件日期：`May 2024`。
- 文件性質：configuration guide；適合查 mandatory configuration、requires / not compatible / retrofitting notes、ordering information、recommended extras 與 service notes。

- 來源：[[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]。
- 文件名稱：`R&S®SMW200A Vector Signal Generator Specifications`。
- 文件代碼：`PD 3606.8037.22`。
- 文件版次：`Version 31.00`。
- 文件日期：`May 2026`。
- 文件性質：產品 specifications；記錄 RF/baseband performance、interfaces、environmental data、ordering information 與 options。

R&S SMW200A › 基本訂購限制
依 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]] 與 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]：

- Base unit：`R&S®SMW200A`，Order No. `1412.0000.02`。
- 原文說明：Vector signal generator；includes power cable and quick start guide。
- Base unit can only be ordered with an `R&S®SMW-B10xx` frequency option and an `R&S®SMW-B13`、`R&S®SMW-B13T` or `R&S®SMW-B13XT` signal routing and baseband main module。
- 最低配置必須包含 RF path A 的一個 frequency option，以及一個 signal routing and baseband main module。
- Step 1 RF path A frequency options 不能 retrofitted。
- Step 2 baseband main module options 可 factory retrofitted；`R&S®SMW-B13XT` retrofitting only for serial number `102700` or higher。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

R&S SMW200A › RF path combination 與 chassis
- RF path combination table：`●` 代表 possible；`–` 代表 not possible；灰底格代表該 RF path combination 需要 `R&S®SMW-B94L` deeper chassis；白底格使用 standard chassis。
- `R&S®SMW-B94L`：Deeper chassis，Order No. `1438.8150.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-B94L` required and only possible for RF path combinations：`2 × 12.75 GHz`、`2 × 31.8 GHz`、`2 × 44 GHz`。
- 44 GHz 組合限制：`R&S®SMW-B1044` 只能與 `R&S®SMW-B2044` 組合；`R&S®SMW-B1044N` 只能與 `R&S®SMW-B2044N` 組合；`R&S®SMW-B1044O` 只能與 `R&S®SMW-B2044O` 組合。

R&S SMW200A › Digital I/Q
- Standard digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K18`；wideband digital baseband outputs 至少需 `R&S®SMW-K19`。
- Digital I/Q input/output 可用於 [[R&S SMW200A]] 與其他 Rohde & Schwarz 儀器之間的 lossless connection，例如 [[R&S SGT100A]]、[[R&S SMM100A]]、[[R&S SMCV100B]] 或 CMW500 wideband radio communication tester 的 fading applications。
- DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface PAD-R`，level `LVDS`，connector `26-pin MDR`。
- HS DIG I/Q interface 符合 `R&S®Digital I/Q Interface 40G PAD-R`，connector `QSFP+/QSFP 28`。
- Wideband HS DIG I/Q standard system configuration mode：40G up to `1.05 GHz`，50G up to `1.25 GHz`；advanced mode with `R&S®SMW-K822` input up to `500 MHz`，with `R&S®SMW-K823` input up to `1000 MHz`。

R&S SMW200A › Digital standards、R&S WinIQSIM2、Pulse Sequencer、MIMO 與 fading
- Internal digital modulation systems 至少需安裝一個 `R&S®SMW-B10` 或 `R&S®SMW-B9`。
- 來源列出 cellular、wireless connectivity、navigation、broadcast 與 other standards options；包含 `GSM/EDGE`、`3GPP FDD`、`LTE Release 8` 到 `Release 15`、`Cellular IoT`、`5G New Radio`、`5G NR Release 16/17`、`IEEE 802.11a/b/g/n/j/p/ac/ax/be/ad/ay`、`Bluetooth EDR/5.x/5.4`、`GNSS`、`DVB-S2/S2X`、`DVB-RCS2`、`LoRa`、`HRP UWB` 等。
- 來源描述 digital standards 不需要 separate PC software；但 waveform packages for signals from [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] 另明列 [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] requires an external PC。判斷：前者指 instrument internal digital standards，後者指 WinIQSIM2 workflow，不合併為單一規則。
- `R&S®SMW-K144`：5G New Radio，Order No. `1414.4990.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K145`：5G New Radio closed-loop BS test，Order No. `1414.6506.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K148`：5G NR Release 16，Order No. `1414.6664.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K170`：5G NR sidelink，Order No. `1413.8640.02`。
- `R&S®SMW-K171`：5G NR Release 17，Order No. `1413.7280.02`。
- [[R&S WinIQSIM2]] requires an external PC；`R&S®SMW-K200` waveform packages 可登錄 1、5 或 50 waveforms，每台 instrument 最多 `250 waveforms`。
- [[R&S Pulse Sequencer]] 相關 options 包含 `R&S®SMW-K300`、`K301`、`K302`、`K304`、`K306`、`K307`、`K308`、`K315`、`K350`。
- Multichannel、MIMO and fading 完整規格另見 `PD 3673.1276.22`；digital standards 完整規格另見 `PD 5213.9434.22`；GNSS/avionics 另見 `PD 3607.6896.22`；Pulse Sequencer 另見 `PD 3607.1388.22`。

R&S FSW
R&S FSW 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 high-end Signal and Spectrum Analyzer 系列，依 Version 17.01（September 2025）涵蓋 8 GHz 至 85 GHz 型號，[[R&S FSW85]] 搭配 R&S FSW-B90G 可延伸至 90 GHz。

R&S FSW › 其他硬體 options（摘錄）

NTN signal generator solutions › Component testing
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 16，component testing 使用 DUT、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S FSW]]：

- [[R&S SMW200A]]：frequency up to 67 GHz，overrange 72 GHz；RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz，up to 4 GHz with [[R&S SMW-K555]]。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] signal generation SW：LTE、Cellular IoT、5G NR R17/18（K171）、OFDM signal generation（K114）、custom digital modulation。
- [[R&S FSW]]：frequency up to 85 GHz，overrange 90 GHz；analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz。
- [[R&S FSW]] signal analysis SW：LTE、Cellular IoT、5G NR R17/18（K171）、OFDM signal analysis（K96）、Vector signal analysis（K70）。

以上是 2025 簡報摘要值；正式產品規格仍需回查 [[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S FSW]] 與其對應 specifications。

NTN signal generator solutions › 來源中的 solution 分層

- Component Testing。
- [[Satellite Access Node]]（[[SAN]]）Testing。
- End-to-end System Testing。
- User Equipment（UE）Testing。

來源可讀內容主要展開前三者，尤其是 [[R&S SMW200A]] 的 channel emulation、[[5G NR SAN conformance testing]] 與 [[SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation]]。

- [[5G NTN validation and testing]]：較寬的 NTN validation、partner collaboration、CMX500 / SMBV100B / Viasat / Gatehouse / MediaTek PR 語境。
- [[NR-NTN conformance testing]]：偏 UE / GCF / PTCRB / TS8980 / CMX500 conformance validation。
- [[5G NR SAN conformance testing]]：本來源新增的 Satellite Access Node 測試概念，聚焦 SAN transmitter、receiver、performance 與 OTA chapters。

NTN signal generator solutions › End-to-end system testing

- satellite trajectory modelling。
- frequency-dependent atmospheric effects。
- longer path delays。
- enhanced Doppler capabilities。
- up to 1073 ms delay。
- up to ±1 MHz Doppler（pure Doppler）。

[[R&S Space Nexus]] 在來源中被描述為 PC Software，available on request，可依 satellite trajectory 產生 [[R&S SMW200A]] fading files。

詳見 [[SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation]]。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › OTA conformance 與 chamber solutions
- Slide 8 把 [[R&S ATS1800C]] 與 [[R&S PWC200]] 列為 OTA testing solutions；ATS1800C 是 FR2 compact test system with high-quality quiet zone，PWC200 是 mid-band Massive MIMO device verification / plane wave converter。
- Slide 8 說 [[R&S PWC200]] 可在近場距離做 far-field measurements，例如 3.5 GHz、1 m aperture 的 5G massive MIMO base station 可在 1.5 m 做 OTA testing，而 direct far-field measurement 需要 23.5 m。
- Slide 9 說 `All 38.141 measurements supported`，並指向 [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]]、5G NR Base Station Transmitter / Receiver / Performance Tests、Signal Generator built-in presets 與 5G NR Test Case Wizard。
- Slide 11 標題為 `5G NR base Station Conformance Testing (R&D) From Conducted to OTA testing`。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › Digital Design & Power / Energy saving
- Slide 14–15 將 highspeed digital and power designs 定位為需要快速、可靠、準確 T&M tools 的 verification / debugging 領域，測試工具包括 [[VNA]]、probes、phase noise analyzer、power supplies、multimeter、oscilloscopes、signal source。
- Slide 16 說 rising energy costs drive MNOs to boost efficiency，base stations and components offer substantial energy-saving potential。
- Slide 17 提出 optimization of power consumption、power statistics over time、device activity versus power consumption、real-time power / voltage / current statistics、up to 800 W / up to four channels；產品包括 [[R&S NGP800]]、[[R&S RTO]] / [[R&S RTP]]、RT-ZHD07 voltage probe、RT-ZC31 current probe。
- Slide 18 提到 measurement-driven development of energy-saving amplifiers、envelope signal for tracker generated in real-time、turnkey solution based on VSG + VSA + SW、dedicated SW applications for Doherty、[[R&S SMW-K546]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K18]]。
- Slide 19 提出 PA load-pull testing，用於確認 PA 在 final design 看到不同 impedance 時的 behavior。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › Network densification、small cells、production 與 private networks
- Slide 25 network densification 包含 FWA for last mile、mmWave radios、sub-6 small cells、repeaters。
- Slide 26 將 [[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S FSV]]、[[R&S FE44A]]、[[R&S CMQ200]]、[[R&S RTP]] / [[R&S RTO]]、[[R&S ZNA]] 等列於 chamber / conformance、small cells、embedded design & power、RF design and compliance 脈絡。
- Slide 27 提出 high-volume testing of mmWave small cells and radio units，產品 / 方案包含 [[R&S CMPHEAD30]]、Wireless Manufacturing Test（WMT），並宣稱 fully validated in QDART、ultrafast measurement speed、parallel testing of multiple DUTs、supported RF bands 29 / 39 / 47、fully automated path correction concept。
- Slide 28–29 private networks 以 healthcare、industries & manufacturers、transport、enterprises / campus / stadiums、mission critical communications、smart city / neutral hosts 等為應用，強調 site acceptance、data analytics、service monitoring、spectrum clearance & interference hunting。
- Slide 30 將 network infrastructure architecture 分為 antenna、RU / radio unit、BBU / baseband unit 與 mobile network，測試活動包含 design & validation、R&D、conformance、calibration、Rx/Tx tests、go/no-go tests、network measurement / analysis / troubleshooting / monitoring、baseband verification、functional performance、RF parametric、RF component & digital design、baseband algorithm、transmitter / receiver / performance tests。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › Spectrum、mmWave 與 early 6G research
- Slide 10 以 `More Spectrum Bands & Higher Frequencies` 連到 transition to 6G 的 RF performance demand。
- Signal generation 產品列名包括 [[R&S SMA100B]] up to 67 GHz、[[R&S SMW200A]] up to 67 GHz、[[R&S SMB100A]] up to 40 GHz、[[R&S SMM100A]] up to 44 GHz、[[R&S SMBV100B]] 3/6 GHz，以及 [[R&S SFI]]、[[FE110ST]]、[[FE170ST]]、[[FC330ST]]、[[FC500ST]] 等 frequency converter / front end。
- Spectrum analysis 產品列名包括 [[R&S FSW]] up to 90 GHz、[[R&S FSVA3050]] up to 50/54 GHz、[[R&S FPS]] up to 40 GHz、[[R&S PVT360A]] / [[R&S CMP200]]、[[FE44S]]、[[FE50DTR]]、[[FC330SR]] 等。
- Network analysis 產品列名包括 [[R&S ZNA]] up to 67 GHz、[[R&S ZNA67EXT]] up to 110 GHz、[[R&S ZNB]]、[[R&S ZVA]] 10 MHz–110 GHz，以及 banded mmW converters up to 1.1 THz。
- Slide 13 early 6G research 提到 up-to 4 GHz signal generation bandwidth、up to 8 GHz signal bandwidth、generic OFDM analysis、4096QAM / multi-modulation 與 flat signals over entire frequency range。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › MIMO、Beamforming 與 OTA
- Slide 4 定義 [[Beamforming]]：透過 bundling transmitted energy 並將能量導向 user 以增加 antenna gain。
- Slide 4 定義 [[MIMO]]：transceiver 端有 many antennas，用於增加 capacity。
- Slide 4 定義 [[Massive MIMO]]：transceiver 端有 very high number of antenna elements，結合 beamforming 與 spatial multiplexing。
- Slide 4 說 operators with mid-band spectrum 對 Massive MIMO 較有信心，例子包括 China、US；並說 beamforming 是提升 system efficiency 的 essential measure，尤其是 mmWave。
- Slide 5 以 `Up to nx8 MIMO Generation & Analysis`、5G NR multi-channel analysis、integrated fading simulation，連到 [[R&S SMW200A]] plus [[R&S SGT100A]] 與 [[R&S VSE]] 5G MIMO analysis software。
- Slide 6 對 beamforming components / accuracy 提出 fully integrated solution、no calibration needed、simultaneous measurement on ≤24 ports within one instrument；產品語彙包括 [[R&S NRPM]]（18 GHz–90 GHz ultra-wideband OTA power measurement solution）與 [[R&S ZNBT]]（multiport network analyzer ≤40 GHz）。
- Slide 7 說 Active Antennas 與 Massive MIMO 使 measured systems 更複雜，高頻使 conducted testing impractical，far-field 條件量測需要 sophisticated T&M solutions；並說 higher frequencies / Massive MIMO 下 OTA testing 將成為必要。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Signal generation、analysis 與 SpaceNexus
來源描述：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可配備 fading emulator，支援 TDL / CDL、custom fading profile、Doppler、delay、path loss，以及 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading。
- [[R&S SpaceNexus]] 可設定 satellite constellation、UE position / mobility、time-variant Doppler、time-variant propagation delay、path loss、weather-induced attenuation，並 remote configure SMW200A。
- [[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSWX]] 支援 satellite payload testing、EVM、ACLR、group delay、DVB-S2X analysis、phase-coherent multichannel measurement。
- [[R&S PVT360A]] 被描述為 potential satellite production testing platform，整合 vector signal generator 與 vector spectrum analyzer。

NTN test and measurement aspects › NTN 對 T&M 的 paradigm change
來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

NTN test and measurement aspects › OTA / phased array / PAAM testing
NTN UE、VSAT、SAN、satellite 可能使用 directive antennas / phased array antennas，因此 OTA testing 重要。

來源整理：

- OTA methods：far field、near field、CATR、plane wave conversion、anechoic chamber、reverberation chamber。
- PAAM metrics：radiation pattern、scan loss、pointing error、HPBW、sidelobe levels、EIRP、G/T、noise density、EVM、beam switching。
- NTN beam metrics：beam center、beam peak、beam pair、beam pointing accuracy、beam stability、beam squint、OSDD、beam shape capability。
- Rohde & Schwarz setups 使用 [[R&S ZNA]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSWX]]、[[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S ATS800B]]、[[R&S ATS800R]]、[[R&S ATS1800M]] 等。

NTN test and measurement aspects › 使用限制
- 本頁是 T&M 技術總覽；正式 test methods、limits、tolerances、test case IDs 與 validation status 需查 [[TS 38.101-5]]、[[TS 38.521-5]]、[[TS 38.523]]、[[TS 38.533]]、[[TS 38.181]]、[[TS 38.108]]、GCF / PTCRB public documents。
- R&S 產品能力需以正式 datasheet / configuration guide 為準；白皮書中的 solution-level 描述不可直接作為 quote / BOM / orderable capability。
- OTA / PAAM setup 的 fixtures、antenna modules、chamber dimensions、quiet zone、polarization、frequency conversions 等需以原圖與 setup note 回查。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › SAN conformance requirements chapters
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 33：

- Chapter 6：Conducted transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。
- Chapter 7：Conducted receiver characteristics。
- Chapter 8：Conducted performance characteristics。
- Chapter 9：Radiated transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。
- Chapter 10：Radiated receiver characteristics。
- Chapter 11：Radiated performance characteristics。

來源同頁說 5G NR options on [[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSVA3000]] support Chapter 6 & 9 measurements。

5G NR SAN conformance testing
[[5G NR SAN conformance testing]] 是 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]]（封面標示 12-2025）中針對 [[Satellite Access Node]]（[[SAN]]）的 [[3GPP]] [[NTN]] conformance testing 應用；來源將它連到 [[3GPP TS 38.108]] 與 [[3GPP TS 38.181]]，並以 [[R&S SMW200A]] 作為 signal generator / channel emulator 的核心。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › 測試對象與架構
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 18，測試對象是 Satellite Access Node（DUT），transparent payload architecture。圖中文字包含：

- Gateway。
- NTN Payload RF。
- gNB。
- Feeder Link Emulator。
- Signal generator。
- Channel emulator for service link。
- Throughput measurement point。

來源 slide 6 說 [[3GPP]] Specification Work in Release 17 and Release 18 focuses on transparent bent-pipe payload architecture。SAN provides NR user plane and control plane protocol terminations towards NTN satellite-capable UE，connected via NG interface to 5GC，and encompasses a transparent NTN payload onboard a NTN platform、a gateway and gNB functions。

5G NR SAN conformance testing › 與 NR-NTN conformance testing 的區分
[[NR-NTN conformance testing]] 既有頁主要整理 [[GCF]] [[WI-555]]、[[PTCRB]] [[RFT 555]]、[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]、[[R&S TS-RRM]]、[[R&S CMX500]] 與 UE / chipset conformance validation PR 語境。

本頁的 [[5G NR SAN conformance testing]] 則聚焦 [[Satellite Access Node]]、[[3GPP TS 38.108]] / [[3GPP TS 38.181]]、SAN transmitter / receiver / performance / OTA chapters，以及 [[R&S SMW200A]] signal generator / channel emulator 配置。兩者同屬 NTN conformance testing，但測試對象、規格與儀器角色不同。

5G NR OTA Base Station Receiver Tests › Signal generation、interferer 與 analyzer
依 [[GFM325_0e_5G_NR_BaseStation_OTA_RX_Tests]]（06.2020）：

- 主要 vector signal generator：[[R&S SMW200A]]。
- 5G NR software option：[[R&S SMW-K144]]。
- OTA calibration options：[[R&S SMW-K544]]、[[R&S FSW-K544]]。
- 7.6 OTA out-of-band blocking 需要額外 CW generator，建議 [[R&S SMA100B]] 搭配 [[R&S SMAB-B167]]，頻率範圍 8 kHz to 67 GHz。
- 7.7 OTA receiver spurious emissions 需要 spectrum analyzer；來源列出 [[R&S FSW]]、R&S FSV、R&S FSVA、[[R&S FSV3000]]、[[R&S FSVA3000]]、R&S FPS。
- 7.8 OTA receiver intermodulation 中，5G NR interfering signal 由 [[R&S SMW200A]] second channel 提供；CW signal 可用 [[R&S SMW-K62]] 產生。

passages.text:
5G NR OTA Base Station Receiver Tests › OTA receiver test cases
來源涵蓋下列 [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]] chapter 7 tests：

| Clause | Test case | 來源摘錄重點 |
|---|---|---|
| 7.2 | OTA sensitivity | OSDD / EIS level；Directional；不適用 [[BS type 2-O]]；throughput ≥ 95%。 |
| 7.3 | OTA reference sensitivity level | EIS_REFSENS；Directional；驗證 OTA REFSENS RoAoA 內 throughput requirement。 |
| 7.4 | OTA dynamic range | Wanted signal 與 AWGN interferer 來自相同方向；Directional；[[BS type 2-O]] requirement 缺漏。 |
| 7.5.1 | OTA adjacent channel selectivity | Wanted signal 搭配 adjacent channel NR interferer；throughput ≥ 95%。 |
| 7.5.2 | OTA in-band blocking | General blocking 與 narrowband blocking；interferer sweep；narrowband blocking 僅適用 [[BS type 1-O]]。 |
| 7.6 | OTA out-of-band blocking | CW interferer；需 external CW generator，例如 [[R&S SMA100B]]；含 co-location blocking。 |
| 7.7 | OTA receiver spurious emissions | TDD BS transmitter OFF period；用 [[TRP]] 方式評估 receiver spurious emissions。 |
| 7.8 | OTA receiver intermodulation | 一個 CW interferer 加一個 5G NR interferer；Directional；throughput ≥ 95%。 |
| 7.9 | OTA in-channel selectivity | 驗證 receiver 抑制 IQ leakage；指定 resource block locations；throughput ≥ 95%。 |

passages.text:
5G NR OTA Base Station Receiver Tests › OTA reference sensitivity level
- Requirement 是 directional requirement。
- OTA REFSENS EIS level declaration 適用於所有 supported polarizations，假設 polarization match。
- 測試步驟包含將 base station 與 test antenna 對準 declared direction、設定 beam peak direction、讓 [[R&S SMW200A]] 送出 5G NR test signal、量測各 supported polarization throughput。

passages.text:
5G NR OTA Base Station Receiver Tests › OTA sensitivity
- Requirement 基於一個或多個 OSDD。
- Test purpose：驗證 BS 能在 OSDD 宣告的 EIS level 與 angles of arrival range 下，對 specified measurement channel 達成 throughput requirement。
- 不適用於 [[BS type 2-O]]。
- Throughput measured 必須大於或等於 reference measurement channel maximum throughput 的 95%。

citation.wiki_page: wiki/concepts/5G NR OTA Base Station Receiver Tests.md

passages.text:
5G NR OTA Base Station Receiver Tests › OTA reference sensitivity power level
OTA reference sensitivity power level（EIS_REFSENS）是在 [[RIB]] 接收的 minimum mean power；在該 power 下，specified reference measurement channel 必須滿足 reference performance requirement。

citation.wiki_page: wiki/concepts/5G NR OTA Base Station Receiver Tests.md

passages.text:
5G NR OTA Base Station Receiver Tests › OTA adjacent channel selectivity
- ACS 衡量 receiver 抑制 adjacent channel interfering signal 的能力。
- BS type 1-O 的 wanted signal mean power 是 EIS minSENS + 6 dB；interfering mean power 依 Wide / Medium / Local area 不同。
- BS type 2-O 使用 EIS REFSENS 與 EIS REFSENS_50M 相關表示式。
- 測試使用 [[R&S SMW200A]] hybrid combiner 彙總 wanted signal 與 interfering signal。

citation.wiki_page: wiki/concepts/5G NR OTA Base Station Receiver Tests.md

passages.text:
5G NR OTA Base Station Receiver Tests › OTA dynamic range
- Interfering signal 是 [[AWGN]]。
- Wanted signal 與 interfering signal 的 incident wave AoA 來自相同方向，且位於 OTA REFSENS RoAoA 內。
- Appendix A 表格列出 Wide area、Medium range、Local area BS 的 dynamic range wanted / interfering mean power，多以 `數值 – ΔOTAREFSENS` 表示。

citation.wiki_page: wiki/concepts/5G NR OTA Base Station Receiver Tests.md

passages.text:
5G NR OTA Base Station Receiver Tests › OTA receiver spurious emissions
- OTA receiver spurious emissions 是 receiver unit 從 antenna array 輻射出的 emissions power。
- FDD BS 不適用，因為 OTA domain 中無法區分 Tx 與 Rx spurious emissions。
- TDD BS requirement 僅適用於 transmitter OFF period。
- Detection mode：True RMS。
- 使用 directional measurements 計算各 frequency 的 [[TRP]]。

citation.wiki_page: wiki/concepts/5G NR OTA Base Station Receiver Tests.md

passages.text:
5G NR conducted base station transmitter tests › R&S solution setup
依 [[GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests]]（01.2021）：

- 完整 Tx test setup 使用 [[R&S FSW]] spectrum analyzer 執行量測。
- 6.7 transmitter intermodulation 使用 [[R&S SMW200A]] signal generator 作為 interferer。
- 5G NR measurements 需 5G NR Downlink Measurements software option：R&S FSW-/FSV3-/FSV-/FPS-/VSE-K144。
- 6.7 interferer 可由 [[R&S SMW200A]] 或 [[R&S SMBV100B]] 搭配 -K144 5G NR software option 產生。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S SMBV100B]] 也可用於示範目的，模擬 5G NR base station；來源明示 vector signal generator 不能模擬所有 base station functions。

- `GFM313_Tx_tests` Python package 提供 [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] chapter 6 test cases 的 Python library。
- Python package 建議使用 Python 3.8、PyCharm IDE、RsInstrument Python module version 1.8.2.45 or higher。

5G NR conducted base station transmitter tests › 涵蓋測項
依 [[GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests]]（01.2021），[[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] chapter 6 測項如下：

| Test case | 名稱 | 測試重點 |
|---|---|---|
| 6.2 | Base station output power | 驗證 maximum carrier output power 準確度。 |

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › Digital Design & Power / Energy saving
- Slide 14–15 將 highspeed digital and power designs 定位為需要快速、可靠、準確 T&M tools 的 verification / debugging 領域，測試工具包括 [[VNA]]、probes、phase noise analyzer、power supplies、multimeter、oscilloscopes、signal source。
- Slide 16 說 rising energy costs drive MNOs to boost efficiency，base stations and components offer substantial energy-saving potential。
- Slide 17 提出 optimization of power consumption、power statistics over time、device activity versus power consumption、real-time power / voltage / current statistics、up to 800 W / up to four channels；產品包括 [[R&S NGP800]]、[[R&S RTO]] / [[R&S RTP]]、RT-ZHD07 voltage probe、RT-ZC31 current probe。

- Slide 19 提出 PA load-pull testing，用於確認 PA 在 final design 看到不同 impedance 時的 behavior。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › Spectrum、mmWave 與 early 6G research
- Slide 10 以 `More Spectrum Bands & Higher Frequencies` 連到 transition to 6G 的 RF performance demand。
- Signal generation 產品列名包括 [[R&S SMA100B]] up to 67 GHz、[[R&S SMW200A]] up to 67 GHz、[[R&S SMB100A]] up to 40 GHz、[[R&S SMM100A]] up to 44 GHz、[[R&S SMBV100B]] 3/6 GHz，以及 [[R&S SFI]]、[[FE110ST]]、[[FE170ST]]、[[FC330ST]]、[[FC500ST]] 等 frequency converter / front end。
- Spectrum analysis 產品列名包括 [[R&S FSW]] up to 90 GHz、[[R&S FSVA3050]] up to 50/54 GHz、[[R&S FPS]] up to 40 GHz、[[R&S PVT360A]] / [[R&S CMP200]]、[[FE44S]]、[[FE50DTR]]、[[FC330SR]] 等。

- Slide 13 early 6G research 提到 up-to 4 GHz signal generation bandwidth、up to 8 GHz signal bandwidth、generic OFDM analysis、4096QAM / multi-modulation 與 flat signals over entire frequency range。

MWC2025---WIC-INFRA › MIMO、Beamforming 與 OTA
- Slide 4 定義 [[Beamforming]]：透過 bundling transmitted energy 並將能量導向 user 以增加 antenna gain。
- Slide 4 定義 [[MIMO]]：transceiver 端有 many antennas，用於增加 capacity。
- Slide 4 定義 [[Massive MIMO]]：transceiver 端有 very high number of antenna elements，結合 beamforming 與 spatial multiplexing。
- Slide 4 說 operators with mid-band spectrum 對 Massive MIMO 較有信心，例子包括 China、US；並說 beamforming 是提升 system efficiency 的 essential measure，尤其是 mmWave。
- Slide 5 以 `Up to nx8 MIMO Generation & Analysis`、5G NR multi-channel analysis、integrated fading simulation，連到 [[R&S SMW200A]] plus [[R&S SGT100A]] 與 [[R&S VSE]] 5G MIMO analysis software。

- Slide 7 說 Active Antennas 與 Massive MIMO 使 measured systems 更複雜，高頻使 conducted testing impractical，far-field 條件量測需要 sophisticated T&M solutions；並說 higher frequencies / Massive MIMO 下 OTA testing 將成為必要。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Signal generation、analysis 與 SpaceNexus
來源描述：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可配備 fading emulator，支援 TDL / CDL、custom fading profile、Doppler、delay、path loss，以及 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading。
- [[R&S SpaceNexus]] 可設定 satellite constellation、UE position / mobility、time-variant Doppler、time-variant propagation delay、path loss、weather-induced attenuation，並 remote configure SMW200A。
- [[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSWX]] 支援 satellite payload testing、EVM、ACLR、group delay、DVB-S2X analysis、phase-coherent multichannel measurement。
- [[R&S PVT360A]] 被描述為 potential satellite production testing platform，整合 vector signal generator 與 vector spectrum analyzer。

NTN test and measurement aspects › NTN 對 T&M 的 paradigm change
來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

- Chapter 6：Conducted transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。

- Chapter 8：Conducted performance characteristics。
- Chapter 9：Radiated transmitter characteristics；spectrum analyzer needed；does not require signal generator。
- Chapter 10：Radiated receiver characteristics。

5G NR SAN conformance testing
[[5G NR SAN conformance testing]] 是 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]]（封面標示 12-2025）中針對 [[Satellite Access Node]]（[[SAN]]）的 [[3GPP]] [[NTN]] conformance testing 應用；來源將它連到 [[3GPP TS 38.108]] 與 [[3GPP TS 38.181]]，並以 [[R&S SMW200A]] 作為 signal generator / channel emulator 的核心。

5G NR OTA Base Station Receiver Tests › Signal generation、interferer 與 analyzer

- 主要 vector signal generator：[[R&S SMW200A]]。
- 5G NR software option：[[R&S SMW-K144]]。
- OTA calibration options：[[R&S SMW-K544]]、[[R&S FSW-K544]]。
- 7.6 OTA out-of-band blocking 需要額外 CW generator，建議 [[R&S SMA100B]] 搭配 [[R&S SMAB-B167]]，頻率範圍 8 kHz to 67 GHz。
- 7.7 OTA receiver spurious emissions 需要 spectrum analyzer；來源列出 [[R&S FSW]]、R&S FSV、R&S FSVA、[[R&S FSV3000]]、[[R&S FSVA3000]]、R&S FPS。
- 7.8 OTA receiver intermodulation 中，5G NR interfering signal 由 [[R&S SMW200A]] second channel 提供；CW signal 可用 [[R&S SMW-K62]] 產生。
